final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS rate_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(rate_per_day) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM step1) SELECT step1.rating, step1.avg_replacement_cost, step1.rate_per_day, step1.rate_per_day / step2.avg_rate_per_day FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.avg_rate_per_day IS NOT NULL
